runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 governs new AI contracts starting **180 days after the memo is issued**. The memo's future-contracts section says this memorandum shall apply to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum.

The same clause also reaches existing contracts in one way: it covers any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum.

The memo does not apply to every AI purchase, since this memorandum does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
